lines.en: Good morning. What would you like?

lines.en: No, we have milk. Only bread.

Kaan Yilmaz.

Nothing. Why do you ask?

Yes. That is my mother and my father.

That is me! I was seven years old.

Ten minutes by bus. You can walk in half an hour.

Yes, but not three. Three is for teachers.

Forty. But try the water first. It is free.

A blue shirt and black shoes.
